title: China Price Check: A $25 Massage That's $120 in New York | China Travel Expert
description:
A one-hour massage in China costs about $25. In New York, the same hour is $120 or more.

Here's the real range: a full-body Tuina session runs roughly ¥150–400 ($21–55), and foot reflexology can start around $15 — with a massage shop on nearly every block. In New York, a standard 60-minute massage sits around $120–145 at mid-range spas and climbs to $250–350 at hotel and luxury day spas. Same hour, very different bill.

🧭 Expert Tip: Look for shops marked 按摩 (massage) or 足疗 (foot reflexology) in ordinary neighborhoods — they usually beat hotel spas on both price and skill. Point at the price board if the menu isn't in English.

在中国按一次一小时的摩,大概$25;在纽约,同样一小时要$120起。
